name: Expressions Washi Tape, Abstract Modern Design, 8 Rolls (C1017-8-P19)
bestUse: Best for borders, corners and tabs
descriptionOriginal: An assorted set of eight washi tape rolls in a modern abstract design, in three widths (7, 10 and 15 mm), from Scotch's Expressions range.
whyWeLikeIt: One strip across a corner is often all a spread needs, and eight rolls give you room to find the shade that suits your book. Scotch lists journaling among the uses of Expressions washi.
limitations: The set is assorted, so you cannot choose individual colours. Scotch advises testing removability on a small hidden area first, so this is tape for decorating paper, not a fix for a page you may want to lift later.
qualityNote: Customers say it is good quality with pretty patterns and vibrant colours. Concern: colourways and width are not stated in the page text, so look at the listing images before choosing it for a palette.
